Banksia robur as emergent shrub in sedge heathland, Curra Moors, Royal National Park
The Brown Honeyeater Lichmera indistincta is just one of more than 210 bird species found in Lake Awoonga, Central Queensland. Here foraging on Banksia robur .

Swamp Banksia, Banksia robur . Royal National Park, NSW Australia, April 2012. Alan Fairley and Philip Moore describe Banksia robur as growing in "swampy or seepage areas and drainage lines". Spot on.
